name: Generative User Interfaces
summary: AI SDK UI guide to generative UI: wiring LLM tool call results into React components to render dynamic UI inside a chat.
description: Documentation page walking through a generative UI chat interface with AI SDK UI: create a tool, add it to streamText, pass its output to a React component, and branch on typed tool parts (tool-<name>, input-available, output-available, output-error) in the UIMessage parts array.
contains: chat interface built with useChat and a streamText API route
weather and stock tool examples rendered as React components
AI SDK 5.0 typed tool parts: tool-<name> with input-available, output-available and output-error states
